achievements.description: Complete Gerlinde Jäger's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Gerlinde Jäger's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: A picture for her book: go to @loc{Rathenfeldt} and photograph a fallow deer.
Saving Sommer's cornfields: in the @loc{Petershain Cornfields}, harvest 2 fallow deer.
The deer and the sea: in south-eastern @loc{Petershain}, photograph a fallow deer with Konigsberg Lake behind it.
The lost son: reach the @loc{Rathenfeldt Strawfields} cabin, then trail Erik's tracks.
Wrapping up the book: photograph Spreeberg Castle and Old Muller, then shoot a picture while standing atop Bohndorf Hill.

achievements.description: Complete Robert Sommer's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Robert Sommer's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional. Sommerfest asks you to use weapons you have gathered while playing.

steps.text: Mr. Sommer's bow: in @loc{Spreeberg}, harvest a fox with a 60 lb bow.
Smell like a deer: in @loc{Konigsberg}, use the @item{Roe Deer Scent} and harvest 3 roe deer.
Controlling the land: harvest a fallow deer in @loc{Hirschdorf}, a red deer in @loc{Rotwald}, a boar in @loc{Hirschfelden}, and a bison in @loc{Rinderland}.
The fox and the scope: use a scoped .270 rifle to harvest a fox 200.00 m or farther from you.
Sommerfest: harvest any animal using any one of four weapons: the scoped Whitlock Model 86 rifle, the Rhino 454 revolver, the Cacciatore 12G shotgun, or the Hawk Edge CB-70.

achievements.description: Complete Vinay Bhandari's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Vinay Bhandari's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional. To create hunting pressure, kill 3 animals with a firearm, or 5 with a silent weapon, all in the same area.

steps.text: Investigating the bison: head to @loc{Rinderland Gorge}, locate the carcass, and collect a blood sample from it.
Stop the disease: harvest 2 sick bison (brucellosis) at @loc{Ernsdorf}.
Population control: in @loc{Rinderland}, harvest 2 female bison.
Clashing with the deer: go to @loc{Jonsdorf} and create hunting pressure.
A last push: go to @loc{Tichenau Lake} and harvest the bison that carries the disease.

achievements.description: Complete Albertina Fleischer's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Albertina Fleischer's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: A trophy to remember: in @loc{Rotwald}, harvest a male red deer with a bronze score or higher.
Red deer canyon: search @loc{Bohndorf Canyon} for 5 piles of red deer droppings.
Stuffin' them all: harvest a red deer, a bison, a wild boar, and a fallow deer, each with a gold score or higher.
Don't ruin the goods: with a .270 rifle, shoot a red deer in the heart and score gold or better on the harvest.
Returning the favor: go to @loc{Bohndorf Hill} and harvest the fatally wounded red deer.

achievements.description: Complete Marwin Tressler's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Marwin Tressler's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional. To create hunting pressure, kill 3 animals with a firearm, or 5 with a silent weapon, all in the same area.

steps.text: Wild boars raving: create hunting pressure in the @loc{Mullerwald Strawfields}, then in the @loc{Ritterstein Strawfields}.
A ton of meat: harvest 10 boars that each weigh at least 100.00 kg.
Hunting for gold: go to @loc{Ritterstein} and create hunting pressure.
Boar beast boss: in the @loc{Mullerwald Logging Area}, harvest the aggressive boar called Sausage.
The radioactive boars: harvest the radioactive boars.

achievements.description: Complete Richard Hope's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Richard Hope's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: A visitor: reach @loc{Hope's Camp}, locate tracks there, photograph them, then trail them.
Investigating bears: in @loc{Balmont}, identify tracks from 3 different bears.
A second visit: harvest 3 blacktail deer.
Unwelcome guest: in @loc{Balmont}, harvest 2 black bears.
Sick papa bear: in @loc{High Lake}, harvest the sickly bear.

achievements.description: Complete Jonathan Trampfine's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Jonathan Trampfine's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: A family picture: photograph 2 different black bears.
For a few samples of poo: collect 3 black bear dropping samples around @loc{Balmont}.
A picture of Mr. Black: go to @loc{Balmont Lake} and take a picture of Mr. Black.
Trampfine is lost: travel to @loc{Kraken Highs}, look around for clues, then trail the tracks you discover.

achievements.description: Complete Fiona Vualez's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Fiona Vualez's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: Wildlife control: go to @loc{Cheelah} and harvest 2 coyotes. The @item{Predator "Jackrabbit" Caller} is optional.
The big coyote tour: harvest coyotes with a .270 rifle in 2 of these regions: @loc{Southern Ridge}, @loc{Lake District}, @loc{Layton Lows}, @loc{Highton Peaks}, @loc{Northern Ridge}.
Late nights with the dogs: go to @loc{Leviathan Lake} and harvest 2 coyotes at night.
A silent hunt: in @loc{Balmont}, harvest 2 coyotes with a bow.
The werecoyote: go to @loc{Cheelah} and harvest the large coyote.

achievements.description: Complete Emily Connors's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Emily Connors's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: Lost writings: go to @loc{Nordern Hiking Cabins}, follow Connors's tracks, pick up the notebook, and leave it at a lookout tower.
Capturing the landscape: photograph the @loc{High Lake Rock Formations}, the @loc{Willipeg Caves}, and the @loc{Cheelah Hiking Village}.
Emily heart elk: in @loc{Calburn}, harvest a Roosevelt elk bull from a hunting stand.
Putting out the fire: go to the smoke pillar in @loc{High Lake} and put out the fire.
End of season: reach @loc{Layton Canyon}, wait at its lookout tower after dark, then harvest the Roosevelt elk bull.

achievements.description: Complete Paul Beatty's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete all of Paul Beatty's main missions.

guide.context: Only main missions count. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: Waiting it out: in @loc{Willipeg}, harvest a moose from a hunting stand.
To the rescue: go to the start of the tracks in @loc{Chopeeka} and follow James's tracks.
Hunting moose: in @loc{Highton River}, harvest a moose from a ground blind.

The circle route: harvest a moose in @loc{Highton Peaks}, a Roosevelt elk in @loc{Northern Ridge}, a coyote in @loc{Southern Ridge}, a bear in @loc{Layton Lows}, and a blacktail deer in the @loc{Lake District}.
Playing the guide: shoot pictures from three lookout towers: @loc{Chopeeka}, @loc{Roonachee}, and @loc{Norden}.

achievements.description: Complete all Central Europe missions
achievements.summary: Complete all main missions in the Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.

guide.context: This unlocks after the five Hirschfelden arcs are done. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: Do the tutorial missions from Cornelia "Conni" Holzer: find a track, shoot and harvest an animal, visit a lookout point, visit an outpost.
Finish the Fleischer, Tressler, Jäger, Sommer, and Bhandari arcs.

achievements.description: Complete all Pacific Northwest missions
achievements.summary: Complete all main missions in the Layton Lake District.

guide.context: This unlocks after the five Layton arcs are done. Side missions are optional.

steps.text: Do the tutorial missions from Colton "Doc" Locke: find a track, shoot and harvest an animal, visit a lookout point, visit an outpost.
Finish the Connors, Beatty, Hope, Trampfine, and Vualez arcs.

achievements.description: Hit an animal from 200+ meters (219+ yards)
achievements.summary: Hit an animal from at least 200 meters (219 yards) away.

guide.context: Richard Hope's side mission at Kraken Rope Bridge asks for the same distance: a blacktail deer from 200.00 m with a scoped rifle.

steps.text: Climb to a high spot with a long view and spot an animal at least 200 meters away.
Hit the animal.

achievements.description: Hit an animal from 400+ meters (438+ yards)
achievements.summary: Hit an animal from at least 400 meters (438 yards) away.

guide.context: Long shots drop a lot, so check your zero first. A weak hit on soft tissue or bone may not hurt a big animal enough.

steps.text: Pick a lookout with a long view where animals stand at about 400 meters.
Set the aiming distance to 300 meters with the Zeroing skill.
Aim near the midpoint between the grid's center mark and the first mark under it.
Use a weapon built for large animals, such as the @item{.300 Canning Magnum Frontier}.

achievements.description: Harvest an albino deer in Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve or the Layton Lake District
achievements.summary: Harvest an albino deer in either the Layton Lake District or the Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Schonfeldt Bunkers} in the Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.
Harvest the albino fallow deer. This is the mission target of Gerlinde Jäger's tenth and last side mission, which opens after her earlier side missions.

achievements.description: Harvest an animal in every subregion in Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve
achievements.summary: Harvest an animal in every subregion of the Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.

guide.context: The Sommer mission Controlling the land already covers four named areas: Hirschdorf, Rotwald, Hirschfelden, and Rinderland.

steps.text: Check the map for the reserve's subregions.
Harvest one animal in each subregion.

achievements.description: Harvest an animal in every subregion in Layton Lake District
achievements.summary: Harvest an animal in every subregion of the Layton Lake District.

steps.text: Harvest an animal in each of the five regions: @loc{Highton Peaks}, @loc{Northern Ridge}, @loc{Southern Ridge}, @loc{Layton Lows} and the @loc{Lake District}.

achievements.description: Find 50 tracks from the same animal
achievements.summary: Find 50 tracks left by the same animal.

guide.context: Trails often go cold. Extend a straight line through your last two finds and keep walking along it. If nothing shows up within 50 to 100 meters, switch to a different animal.

steps.text: Pick one animal and follow its tracks, finding a new one each time.
Keep following the same animal until you have found 50 tracks.

achievements.summary: Find 100 tracks left by the same animal.

achievements.summary: Spot 100 animals.

guide.context: Animals tend to gather at watering places, so spotting is quicker there.

achievements.description: Harvest different animals using each of the four weapon types
achievements.summary: Use each of the four weapon types to harvest animals, a different animal each time.

guide.context: The weapon types in the missions are rifle, shotgun, handgun, and bow. Use a different animal for each one.

Harvest a different animal with a shotgun.
Harvest another different animal with a handgun.
Harvest another different animal with a bow.

achievements.summary: Land a hit on an animal that you can hardly see.

steps.text: Shoot an animal that you can barely see.

achievements.description: Harvest a wounded animal
achievements.summary: Harvest an animal that was wounded and ran away.

guide.context: Shots to the stomach or intestines kill slowly, so the animal runs off wounded.

steps.text: Shoot an animal in the stomach or intestines so it survives the hit and runs, then follow it, down it and harvest it.

achievements.description: Use all callers once
achievements.summary: Use every caller once.

guide.context: The Predator "Jackrabbit" Caller is one caller. Callers lure animals, and using one two or three times in a row can help.

steps.text: Get each caller you have access to.
Use each caller one time while hunting.

achievements.description: Down an animal at night
achievements.summary: Down an animal at night.

guide.context: Two side missions ask for the same thing: a whitetail or blacktail at night at Lake Cheelah, and any deer at night at Petershain.

steps.text: Hunt after dark and down any animal.

steps.text: Walk through every region of the Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.

achievements.description: Hit an animal while undetected within 15 meters (16 yards)
achievements.summary: Hit an animal that has not noticed you from 15 meters (16 yards) or closer.

guide.context: Watch wind direction, noise, and visibility. A caller or a blind can bring animals close.

steps.text: Approach slowly, keeping the wind in your face and your noise low.
Wait until the animal is within 15 meters and still has not noticed you.
Take the shot.

steps.text: Do Emily Connors's mission "End of season": go to @loc{Layton Canyon}, then visit its lookout tower during the night and harvest the Roosevelt elk bull. After the harvest, check the animal's rating.

achievements.description: Complete Dr. Anatoly Barnyashev's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in Dr. Anatoly Barnyashev's Medved-Taiga mission arc.

steps.text: Do @npc{Dr. Anatoly Barnyashev}'s missions in Lesnye Lands: harvest a musk deer without damaging its lungs, then a wild boar without damaging its lungs that also passes the harvest check.
Next, go to P'yanyy Forest and get 3 separate musk deer spotted.

Hunt lynx around P'yanaya Taiga three times. The first must pass the harvest check. The second must keep its lungs undamaged. The third must also keep its lungs undamaged and earn a bronze score or better.
Take one reindeer by shooting its spine. Hitting no major organ also works.
For the two money missions, take 2 wild boars at a Consecutive Harvest score of 20 or above. Then take 2 more that earn a bronze score or better.
Go to Zverolova Hill. Follow the tracks of 3 separate brown bears, then get 2 separate brown bears spotted.

achievements.description: Complete Dr. Columbus Neidell's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in Dr. Columbus Neidell's Medved-Taiga mission arc.

guide.context: The fifth painting is by the albino bear's den, which you reach through the Alena Khasavovna mission arc.

steps.text: Photograph the four cave paintings Neidell names: a fisherman in the south-east hills of Rybatskiy Bay, hunters stalking Irish elk in south Lesnye Lands, ancient mariners on Zverolova Hill, and bear hunters on the north-west side of Hollowed Mountain.
Kill a brown bear with one bullet.
Photograph the cave painting next to the albino bear's den.

achievements.description: Complete Dimitri "Dimi" Pushkin's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in Dimitri "Dimi" Pushkin's Medved-Taiga mission arc.

steps.text: Do the early Federal eco service missions: harvest a musk deer, a wild boar at Rybatskiy Bay, and a moose that passes the harvest check.
Take a reindeer at Zabolochennye Lands. Then, at Ledyanoy Bay, take a brown bear whose Trophy Rating is 22 or above and whose quick kill bonus is 25 or above.
Harvest 2 reindeer. Then harvest a reindeer at night.
Go to Zverolova Hill and take 2 reindeer. Both must pass the harvest check, and your Consecutive Harvest must reach 20 or more.
For the two influential person missions, shoot a moose of 500.00 kg or more, then a male moose rated 147 or above in Trophy Rating.
On Besplodnoye Plateau, down 3 reindeer while standing at least 80.00 m from each. Then take one reindeer that rates silver or better.

achievements.description: Complete Georgy Grankin's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in Georgy Grankin's Medved-Taiga mission arc.

steps.text: Bring a boar that is 90.00 kg or lighter.
Use a bow on a musk deer that is 14.00 kg or lighter.
Bring a moose that is 390.00 kg or lighter. Then bring a reindeer that is 90.00 kg or lighter.
Travel to the area your HunterMate marks and locate Grankin's trap.
Take a lynx that weighs 28.00 or more.
Take a male brown bear scoring 24 or more on Trophy Rating.
Take a brown bear that has an uncommon, rare, or very rare Fur Type and a Trophy Rating from 23.8 up.

achievements.description: Complete Katerina Khasavovna's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in Katerina Khasavovna's Medved-Taiga mission arc.

steps.text: On Besplodnoye Plateau, shoot a brown bear dead from 100.00 m or farther.
Find the Nenets' sacred place in the region marked on your HunterMate.
Harvest a male moose that passes the harvest check.
Shoot 2 wild boars dead, each from 100.00 m or farther.
Climb to Besplodnoye Plateau Northern Lookout Point and photograph the sunrise between 6am and 7am.
Kill one lynx using a bow. Kill another lynx that goes down within 40.00 m of you.

achievements.description: Complete Dr. Svetlana Isakova's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in Dr. Svetlana Isakova's Medved-Taiga mission arc.

steps.text: Photograph the fishing village at Chekurovka and Two River Village.
In P'yanyy Forest, photograph the Permafrost Crater and harvest a moose.
Photograph the Lenskiye Pillars in the south-east corner of Lesnye Lands.
Find the weather station in the hills of east Lesnye Lands and interact with it.

achievements.description: Complete all missions in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission in the Medved-Taiga National Park mission arcs.

guide.context: The seven arc achievements together cover all 82 Medved-Taiga missions, 32 main and 50 side, so earn them first.

steps.text: Finish the Alena Khasavovna main arc and the Barnyashev, Neidell, Pushkin, Grankin, Katerina Khasavovna and Isakova arcs.

achievements.description: Complete Dr. Alena Khasavovna's mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.
achievements.summary: Complete Dr. Alena Khasavovna's main mission arc in Medved-Taiga National Park.

steps.text: Do the first missions in order: harvest your first animal, scale a lookout point, claim an outpost, and harvest an animal for Gunther.
Search for Gunther: reach his first camp and follow his tracks, reach his second camp and harvest the wounded reindeer, then follow his tracks and read his note.
Check three weather stations, then harvest 2 wild boars in the marked region.
Travel to the P'yanaya Taiga Western Outpost, search the area for a predator, then search the marked area for Chuchunya evidence.
Activate the weather station inside the permafrost crater, then go to the P'yanaya Taiga Central Outpost and look around for traces of the earlier expedition team.
Photograph and harvest a lynx in Lesnye Lands, then harvest 3 boars in the marked part of Lesnye Lands.
Go to the Kholm Zverolova Eastern Outpost, inspect the broken ATV, then find and photograph the Bigfoot tracks and follow them.
Visit Grankin's cabin: enter and search it, photograph the fake Bigfoot feet and take his shotgun.
Harvest the wounded bear, harvest a reindeer or a moose, fix the broken bridge, then harvest any animal except a reindeer.
Travel to the Vetrenyye Plains Western Outpost, then to Zhizhi Spring and photograph a Nenet's reindeer.
Harvest a lynx in the marked region, then visit and interact with the sacred landmark.
Follow the missing reindeer's tracks to the lynx tracks, then to the bear tracks and photograph them, and harvest the wounded reindeer.
Find the bear tracks in the marked area and follow them, then wait out the snowstorm at Besplodnoye Plateau Eastern Outpost.
Photograph and harvest the sick lynx, then enter the cave on Pustaya Mountain and harvest the albino brown bear.
Finish at the top of Besplodnoye Plateau Northern Lookout Point.

achievements.description: Harvest 5 animals from the same herd with a single shot to the heart using a bow in Medved-Taiga National Park
achievements.summary: In Medved-Taiga National Park, kill 5 members of one herd, each with one bow shot into the heart.

guide.context: Back up the folder Documents\Avalanche Studios\COTW\Saves before the attempt, so a failed try does not cost you the herd.

steps.text: Back up your save folder first.
Find a reindeer herd, for example one that drinks near the Vetrenyye Plains Southern Outpost.
Creep close, keeping the wind and your visibility in mind.
Use a decoy every few seconds and shoot each animal once in the heart. A crossbow also works.
After each kill, use the decoy again so the herd comes back. Repeat until 5 animals are down.
If you slip, load your backup save and try again.

achievements.description: Find a feeding track, drinking track and a resting track made by a fallow deer
achievements.summary: Come across three kinds of fallow deer tracks: feeding, drinking and resting.

steps.text: Go to a fallow deer feeding, drinking or resting area in Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.
Find one track of each kind from a fallow deer.

achievements.description: Spot 12 unique red deer from a distance of less than 25 m (27 yards)
achievements.summary: Spot 12 different red deer from less than 25 m away.

guide.context: A decoy at close range often scares the whole herd, so approach quietly instead.

steps.text: Find a red deer need zone and sneak up while the herd is busy, watching noise and wind.
Spot each red deer from under 25 m until you reach 12 different ones.

achievements.description: Harvest a male and a female roe deer from the same herd
achievements.summary: Kill both a buck and a doe of roe deer that share a herd.

steps.text: Find a roe deer herd, which holds one male and one female.
Harvest both animals.

achievements.description: Harvest a European bison with a single shot to the heart using a bow
achievements.summary: Kill a European bison using one bow shot that strikes the heart.

steps.text: Find a European bison in Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve.
Hit its heart once with a bow so it dies from that shot.

achievements.description: Harvest a red fox from a surveyed lookout point
achievements.summary: Kill a red fox while standing at a lookout point you have surveyed.

guide.context: Foxes often run past this lookout point, but they stop coming if you have scared the area's animals away.

steps.text: Visit Ernsdorf Lookout Point in Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve (map coordinates -9452, 10915).
Wait there for a fox to pass and harvest it from the lookout point.

achievements.description: Harvest a whitetail deer from a hunting structure using a bow
achievements.summary: Use a bow to kill a whitetail deer while you are in a hunting structure.

steps.text: Climb into a hunting structure in Layton Lake District.
Shoot a whitetail deer with a bow from inside it.

achievements.description: Harvest a blacktail deer with a single shot from a rifle using only iron sights from a distance of more than 150 meters (164 yards)
achievements.summary: Harvest a blacktail deer with one rifle shot using only iron sights from more than 150 meters.

guide.context: A strong rifle such as the .300 Canning Magnum Frontier helps the single shot kill.

steps.text: Equip a rifle without a scope and use its iron sights.
Shoot a blacktail deer once from more than 150 meters.

achievements.description: Identify a mating call from a Roosevelt elk from a distance of less than 25 meters (27 yards)
achievements.summary: Hear and identify a Roosevelt elk mating call while within 25 meters of the elk.

steps.text: Sneak close to a Roosevelt elk herd, or lure it toward your hiding place with a caller.
Use the caller in short bursts until a female answers with a mating call within 25 meters.

achievements.description: Harvest two coyotes from the same pack with a shotgun
achievements.summary: Use a shotgun to kill two coyotes that run in one pack.

steps.text: Find a coyote pack on the shore of the Norden area in Layton Lake District.
Harvest two of its coyotes with a shotgun.

achievements.description: Harvest a moose with Quick Kill bonus and pass the harvest check.
achievements.summary: Kill a moose, earning the quick kill bonus, and also clear the harvest check.

steps.text: Find a moose in Layton Lake District and kill it fast enough for the Quick Kill bonus, without damage that fails the harvest check.

achievements.description: Harvest a wild boar at night with a handgun
achievements.summary: Use a handgun to kill a wild boar after dark.

steps.text: Go to a boar area in Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve at night.
Take a wild boar with a handgun.

achievements.description: Harvest a blond, brown, and cinnamon-colored black bear
achievements.summary: Harvest a blond, a brown and a cinnamon black bear.

guide.context: Fur colors are random, so keep hunting black bears until all three have dropped.

steps.text: Find black bears in Layton Lake District.
Harvest one black bear of each color: blond, brown and cinnamon.

achievements.description: Complete all the Vurhonga Savanna Mission arcs
achievements.summary: Complete every Vurhonga Savanna mission arc.

steps.text: Finish the Warden missions, then the Mboweni, Ospreay, Maritz and Brother arcs.

achievements.description: Complete the Warden Mission arcs
achievements.summary: Complete the Warden mission arcs in Vurhonga Savanna.

guide.context: This is Njabulo Tshabangu's main and side missions.

steps.text: Play Njabulo's 16 main missions from Welcome to Vurhonga to The Ghost Tree.
Then finish his side missions, such as the springbok, wildebeest, jackal, hare and cape buffalo tasks.

achievements.description: Complete Maria Mboweni's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Maria Mboweni's mission arc in Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Do Maria Mboweni's seven missions in order, starting with a springbok harvest in Vuxa.
Ceremonial Warthog needs a handgun kill with a Quick Kill Bonus of 100.
The Old Way needs a bow or crossbow kill on a cape buffalo in N'walungu.

achievements.description: Complete Flip Ospreay's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Flip Ospreay's mission arc in Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Do Flip Ospreay's missions in order, starting with a photo of any animal in the Dzonga.
Museum Mpfundla needs three scrub hares killed with a shotgun.
Technical Demonstration needs a heart-shot kill from 75.00 m or more and 2 springbok downed with a shotgun.
Finish with the rifle, handgun, shotgun and bow challenges that follow.

achievements.description: Complete Dana Maritz's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Dr. Dana Maritz's mission arc in Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Do Dr. Dana Maritz's nine missions in order, from Begin the Maritz Test to The Maritz Final Exam.
King of Rifles needs 3 animals downed with the King 470DB, and Master of Widowmakers needs a cape buffalo downed with it at gold or better.

achievements.description: Complete Brother's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Brother's mission arc in Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Do Brother's seven missions in order, from Fecal Matters to Heart to Heart to Heart.
Some missions are at night or with a bow, so check each objective before you start.

achievements.description: Harvest every animal species in Vurhonga Savanna
achievements.summary: Harvest one of every animal species in Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Harvest at least one of each species that lives in Vurhonga Savanna.
Check the Codex animal list for the reserve to see which species you still need.

achievements.description: Find Rambolo, the last rhino of Vurhonga Savanna
achievements.summary: Locate Rambolo, the final rhino in Vurhonga Savanna.

guide.context: Finding Rambolo is part of the main mission The Last Rhino.

steps.text: Follow Njabulo's main missions until The Last Rhino.
Find Rambolo, the rhino, when the mission asks.

achievements.description: Spot 50 lesser kudu
achievements.summary: Spot 50 lesser kudu in Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Go to a watering place in lesser kudu habitat.
Spot every kudu you see until the count reaches 50.

achievements.description: Harvest a cape buffalo downed by the King 470DB
achievements.summary: Harvest a cape buffalo that the King 470DB killed.

guide.context: Cape buffalo live in N'walungu.

steps.text: Go to N'walungu and find a cape buffalo.
Down it with the King 470DB and harvest it.

achievements.description: Harvest 25 springbok
achievements.summary: Harvest 25 springbok.

guide.context: Springbok are common in Vuxa.

steps.text: Harvest springbok in Vuxa until you reach 25.

achievements.description: Harvest an animal in every subregion in Vurhonga Savanna
achievements.summary: Harvest an animal in every subregion of Vurhonga Savanna.

steps.text: Harvest any animal in each subregion on the reserve map.
Subregions include Vuxa, Dzonga, Vupeladyambu and N'walungu.

achievements.description: Restore power to the Parque Fernando Hunting Lodge
achievements.summary: Get electricity running again at the hunting lodge in Parque Fernando.

guide.context: The lodge power missions come from Carolina Vargas's main missions.

steps.text: Play the main missions Salvage Operation, Flip the Switch, Testing the Wind, Sol de Mayo and The Last Hangup.

achievements.displayName: The Truth is in the Milanesa
achievements.description: Complete Carolina Vargas' mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Carolina Vargas' mission arc.

steps.text: Do every mission Carolina Vargas gives, starting with Welcome to Patagonia.
Her side missions include Shot for Shot, Animal Whisperer, Special Delivery, The Gold Mine and Cornered.

achievements.description: Complete one of Carolina's Challenge Targets
achievements.summary: Complete one of Carolina's Challenge Targets.

steps.text: Find a stone circle in Parque Fernando.
Stand inside the circle and shoot the target that appears.

achievements.description: Complete all of Carolina's Challenge Targets
achievements.summary: Complete all of Carolina's Challenge Targets.

guide.context: Try several weapons if a target is hard.

steps.text: Find every stone circle in Parque Fernando.
Stand in each circle and shoot its target.

achievements.description: Complete Parque Fernando's Trophy Collection
achievements.summary: Complete Parque Fernando's Trophy Collection.

guide.context: Each animal must be a diamond trophy. Each one must then be added to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Cinnamon teal
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond cinnamon teal, then add the trophy to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Blackbuck
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond blackbuck, then add the trophy to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Axis deer
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond axis deer, then add the trophy to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Puma
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond puma, then add the trophy to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Mule deer
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond mule deer, then add the trophy to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Red deer
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond red deer, then add the trophy to the lodge.

collectibles.name: Water buffalo
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond water buffalo, then add the trophy to the lodge.

achievements.description: Harvest seven unique animal species in Parque Fernando
achievements.summary: Harvest seven different animal species in Parque Fernando.

steps.text: Harvest one animal of each of seven species in Parque Fernando.

achievements.description: Complete Vicente Vargas' mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Vicente Vargas' mission arc.

steps.text: Do Vicente Vargas's six missions in order, from Seal of Approval to Dinner for Two.
Sharpshooter Certification needs a rifle kill from 100.00 m or more with a Quick Kill Bonus of 100.

achievements.description: Complete Beatriz Cabrera's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Beatriz Cabrera's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Beatriz Cabrera's missions in order, from Gunslinger to Puma Control.

achievements.description: Complete Matias Mateo's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Matias Mateo's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Matias Mateo's five missions in order, from A Study in Blackbuck to A Saddle for Beatriz.

achievements.description: Complete Dr. Mariana Luna's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Dr. Mariana Luna's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Dr. Mariana Luna's missions in order, from Poisoned Fruit to Resting Behavior.

achievements.description: Complete Juliana Ferrari's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Juliana Ferrari's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Juliana Ferrari's missions in order, from Lodge Showcase to Word-of-Mouth.

achievements.description: Complete Sandy Murray's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Sandy Murray's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Sandy Murray's missions in order, from A Book By Its Cover to Keep It Clean.

achievements.description: Complete Oscar Freeman's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Oscar Freeman's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Oscar Freeman's missions in order, from A Fine Specimen to Predator Becomes The Prey.

achievements.description: Complete Kayla Johnson's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Kayla Johnson's mission arc.

guide.context: Several missions need a bow or crossbow on grizzly bears.

steps.text: Do Kayla Johnson's eight missions in order, from Show Me Whatchoo Got to Becoming The Alpha.
Becoming The Alpha needs one grizzly killed with a single bow or crossbow shot to the heart, plus a gold Game Score or better.

achievements.description: Complete Hank Pepper's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Hank Pepper's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Hank Pepper's missions in order, from The Perfect Shot to Yukon Gold Rush.

achievements.description: Complete Bev Parker's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Bev Parker's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Bev Parker's missions in order, from Attack Is The Best Defense to Yukon Valley's Best View.

achievements.description: Witness the forest fire in Yukon Valley
achievements.summary: Witness the forest fire in Yukon Valley.

guide.context: It comes from the main mission Flash Point.

steps.text: Play Jim Murray's main missions up to Flash Point and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete the Yukon Valley main mission arc
achievements.summary: Finish the main mission line in Yukon Valley.

steps.text: Finish all of Jim Murray's main missions, from Welcome to Alaska on.

achievements.description: Complete all the Yukon Valley mission arcs
achievements.summary: Complete every Yukon Valley mission arc.

steps.text: Finish the main arc and the Kayla Johnson, Bev Parker, Sandy Murray, Hank Pepper and Oscar Freeman arcs.

achievements.description: Harvest your first grizzly bear
achievements.summary: Harvest a grizzly bear.

steps.text: Hunt a grizzly bear in Yukon Valley and harvest it.

achievements.description: Harvest an albino gray wolf
achievements.summary: Harvest an albino gray wolf.

guide.context: Albino wolves are very rare among gray wolves, and white wolves are common look-alikes.

steps.text: Check every gray wolf you spot to see whether it is a true albino.
Watch watering holes in gray wolf habitat between 00:00 and 03:00.
Harvest the albino wolf.

achievements.description: Complete the mission The Red Carpet
achievements.summary: Complete the mission The Red Carpet.

steps.text: Play Alejandra Del Bosque Garcia's main missions in order until The Red Carpet, then finish it.

achievements.description: Complete Padre Abbas' mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Padre Abbas' mission arc.

steps.text: Do Padre Abbas's missions in order, from Find Yourself in Nature to In the Pilgrim's Footsteps.
Iberia's Crowning Glory needs photos of Beceite, Gredos, Southeastern Spanish and Ronda Spanish ibex.

achievements.description: Harvest Fantasma, Ogro and Sombra
achievements.summary: Harvest Fantasma, Ogro and Sombra.

guide.context: Fantasma and Ogro come from main missions. Sombra comes from Gerhardt Baden's last mission.

steps.text: Harvest Fantasma in the main mission Bait & Switch.
Harvest Ogro in the main mission Divine Reckoning.
Harvest Sombra in Gerhardt Baden's last mission, Baden's Folly.

achievements.description: Complete the Cuatro Colinas main mission arc
achievements.summary: Finish the main mission line in Cuatro Colinas.

steps.text: Finish all of Alejandra Del Bosque Garcia's main missions, from Bienvenidos a Cuatro Colinas to Divine Reckoning.

achievements.description: Complete all of the Cuatro Colinas mission arcs
achievements.summary: Complete every Cuatro Colinas mission arc.

steps.text: Finish the main arc and the arcs of Padre Abbas, Gerhardt Baden, Antonia Acosta Gonzalez, Sole Santiago Serrano, Don Del Bosque and Jose Ruiz Hernandez.

achievements.description: Harvest a diamond male ibex of every ibex species in Cuatro Colinas
achievements.summary: Harvest a diamond male ibex of every ibex species in Cuatro Colinas.

guide.context: The four ibex kinds all live in a small area.

collectibles.name: Beceite ibex
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond male Beceite ibex.

collectibles.name: Gredos ibex
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond male Gredos ibex.

collectibles.name: Southeastern Spanish ibex
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond male Southeastern Spanish ibex.

collectibles.name: Ronda Spanish ibex
collectibles.method: Harvest a diamond male Ronda Spanish ibex.

achievements.description: Complete Gerhardt Baden's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Gerhardt Baden's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Gerhardt Baden's missions in order, from G.O.A.T. to Baden's Folly.
Baden's Folly needs a night hunt for his wolf.

achievements.description: Complete Antonia Acosta Gonzalez's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Antonia Acosta Gonzalez's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Antonia "Nina" Acosta Gonzalez's missions in order, from Fresh Ingredients to The Perfect Liebre.

achievements.description: Complete Sole Santiago Serrano's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Sole Santiago Serrano's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Sole Santiago Serrano's missions in order, from Save Some for Me to Lake Woe; Be Gone.

achievements.description: Complete Don Del Bosque's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Don Del Bosque's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Don Miguel Del Bosque's missions in order, from In Memoriam to Just Like Old Times.
The Jewel in the Crown needs a diamond ibex.

achievements.description: Complete Jose Ruiz Hernández's mission arc
achievements.summary: Complete Jose Ruiz Hernandez's mission arc.

steps.text: Do Mayor Hernandez's missions in order, from Blow the House Down to Press the Flesh.

achievements.description: Harvest 50 turkeys
achievements.summary: Harvest 50 turkeys.

guide.context: Merriam's turkeys gather at watering places in the afternoon.

steps.text: Set model lures and a turkey decoy near a watering place in turkey habitat.
Hunt turkeys there in the hour after 3:00 pm until you reach 50.

achievements.displayName: You give love a bad name
achievements.description: Down 10 animals by hitting them in the heart with the Alexander Longbow in a single shot
achievements.summary: Down 10 animals with single Alexander Longbow shots to the heart.

steps.text: Find a herd and sneak close, upwind of the animals.
Land a one-shot heart hit with the Alexander Longbow, then use a decoy to call the herd back.

achievements.description: Harvest a diamond turkey
achievements.summary: Harvest a diamond turkey.

guide.context: Diamond turkeys are rare, so use lures.

steps.text: Set up model lures and a turkey decoy at a watering place in turkey habitat.
Check each arriving turkey and harvest a diamond one.

achievements.description: Take a picture of the dinosaur footprints
achievements.summary: Photograph the dinosaur footprints.

guide.context: This unlock can be buggy.

steps.text: Go to the dinosaur footprints site.
Photograph the stone mound with the attraction description, not just the tracks.

achievements.description: Down a plains bison with one single shot using the Alexander Longbow
achievements.summary: Down a plains bison with one shot from the Alexander Longbow.

steps.text: Find a plains bison and sneak close.
Down it with a single Alexander Longbow shot.

achievements.summary: Complete the mission A Dangerous Reaction.

steps.text: Play Allan Bradley's main missions in order until A Dangerous Reaction, then finish it.

achievements.summary: Complete the mission Bear with Me.

steps.text: Play Allan Bradley's main missions in order until Bear with Me, then finish it.

achievements.summary: Complete the mission Old Haunts.

steps.text: Play Allan Bradley's main missions in order until The Ascent, then finish it.
